purpose: v9.3-warmup FLAGSHIP: the sweep winner recipe (render 2.0 / consistency 2.0, 5k linear coupling warmup) at the 100k operating budget, two seeds (0, 1). Winner selection followed the pre-declared sweep rule: only arm passing on-figure >= .85 AND TVR <= .538 (scored .912 / .493; TF divergence .2977). Purpose: (a) the released reference flagship of the testbed, (b) seed replication for the paper's rig-co-generation headline (v9 family currently single-seed at 100k), (c) convergence check that the warmup advantage persists at 10x budget (the constant-coupling failure and the v8 300k re-freeze both warn that 10k verdicts can invert at scale). Milestones evaluated under the standing convergence rule; judgment: flagship claim requires 100k TVR at or below the v9.0 conv run (.126 at 100k... to be scored by the same eval), motion within the v8 operating band, on-figure >= .85 sustained, and TF divergence <= v9.0 100k .2870 within noise. Divergence scored per checkpoint at 10k/40k/100k.
